statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess efficacy of current rate control management
